title: Bobby Ray Inman acknowledges the National Underwater Reconnaissance Office
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Bobby Ray Inman acknowledges the National Underwater Reconnaissance Office, about post-retirement; Cold War era at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
